headline: Last session: Sensex jumped nearly 900 points while Nifty reclaimed 22,500 led by a rally in IT stocks

marketStatus.message: Market is closed today because it is a weekend. It will reopen on Monday, 12 October.

why: IT stocks surged 3% in the last session, led by a significant recovery in TCS shares
The FMCG sector gained over 2% as the market rebounded from an 18-month low hit earlier in the week
Nifty bulls regained momentum after a sharp sell-off, pushing the index back above the 22,500 mark
Middle East supply risks are keeping Brent crude oil prices elevated with a war premium
whatHappening: Reliance's Jio is taking a Rs 30,000 crore IPO pitch to global marquee investors for a larger stake
Market experts are analyzing AI company valuations for Meta and Alphabet ahead of third-quarter earnings
Investors are monitoring five key factors that will decide the market's direction in the coming week
Political developments and protests are creating a backdrop of domestic uncertainty for the government
summary: On the last trading day, Indian markets recovered sharply with the Sensex gaining 900 points and Nifty reclaiming the 22,500 level, driven by a 3% jump in IT stocks. Over the weekend, focus has shifted to Jio's global IPO pitch and geopolitical risks affecting oil prices. The market remains closed today for the weekend and will reopen on Monday.
